title: Design System: 北外中东欧研究中心内部使用

motion.name: object-workface
motion.purpose: Anime.js scope可撤销；减少动效终态。

composition.materials: Compact period context and original destination; actual version columns with submission/reviews on the same axis; readable stacked groups on compact screens, no automatic text shrinking.
composition.reading: One return and compact article header; comparison under reader tools; retained query/canvas.
composition.profiles: Introduction and works lead; maintenance/section tools follow content.
composition.discovery: Large canvas with direct candidates and back-to-exploration scroll destinations, same retained canvas/camera.

bookshelf.scope: journal and saved results only; issue153
bookshelf.motion: Anime.js 4.5.0 / 240ms outExpo, scope revert on cancellation; reduced motion direct final state
bookshelf.composition: Only selected journal/year or topic partitions contain books; source title-index partitions and equivalent native lists; institutions stay directory rows.

components.name: 主要操作
components.description: 有权执行的具体版本操作。
components.css: .ds-button{font:500 15px/1.5 "Noto Sans CJK SC","Microsoft YaHei","Segoe UI",sans-serif;padding:8px 14px;min-height:40px;border:1px solid #354ac5;border-radius:6px;background:#354ac5;color:#fff;transition:background .15s,color .15s,border-color .15s}.ds-button:hover{background:#273a9d;border-color:var(--primary-hover)}.ds-button:focus-visible{outline:3px solid #354ac5;outline-offset:3px}.ds-button:disabled{background:#edf0f4;color:#607080}
